app.name: Amazon S3 Tables Observability
app.description: Observe Amazon S3 Tables operations, Iceberg topology, schema, and cost.

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: read s3tables.iceberg.* and native cloud.aws.s3.tables.* metrics

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: read S3 Tables schema state / schema change events

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: read Grail buckets backing metrics and events
